focus.title: 美国拟对东南亚光伏产品加征反倾销税，中国转口企业需警惕溯源风险
focus.summary: 美国商务部初步裁定，对来自越南、泰国、马来西亚和柬埔寨的光伏电池及组件加征反倾销税，税率最高达271%。这是继2022年反规避调查后的进一步行动，重点打击中国企业通过东南亚转口规避关税的行为。涉案企业需在30天内提交成本及供应链证明文件，否则将适用惩罚性税率。建议相关企业立即审查原产地合规性，评估供应链调整方案。
focus.title_en: US Proposes Anti-Dumping Duties on Southeast Asian Solar Products; Chinese Re-Exporters Face Traceability Risks
focus.summary_en: The U.S. Department of Commerce preliminarily determined to impose anti-dumping duties of up to 271% on solar cells and modules from Vietnam, Thailand, Malaysia, and Cambodia. This follows the 2022 circumvention investigation, targeting Chinese companies circumventing tariffs via Southeast Asia. Affected firms must submit cost and supply chain documentation within 30 days or face penalty rates. Companies should immediately review origin compliance and evaluate supply chain adjustments.

case.title: 新加坡国际仲裁中心裁决：跨境特许经营协议中“最惠国条款”的适用边界
case.summary: SIAC在一起中马企业特许经营纠纷案中裁定，特许人给予第三方更优惠的续约条件时，被特许人可援引“最惠国条款”要求同等对待，但该条款不自动适用于新设加盟店。仲裁庭强调，条款的适用范围须明确约定，否则仅限相同业务模式。该裁决提示中国企业起草或谈判跨境合同时，需细化最惠国条款的触发条件与覆盖范围。
case.source: 来源：新加坡国际仲裁中心 · 2026年7月
case.title_en: SIAC Ruling: Scope of Most-Favored-Nation Clause in Cross-Border Franchise Agreements
case.summary_en: In a franchise dispute between Chinese and Malaysian enterprises, the Singapore International Arbitration Center (SIAC) ruled that a franchisee may invoke the most-favored-nation (MFN) clause to demand equivalent terms when the franchisor offers more favorable renewal conditions to a third party. However, the clause does not automatically apply to new franchise outlets. The tribunal emphasized that the scope of the clause must be explicitly defined, otherwise limited to the same business model. This ruling advises Chinese companies to specify trigger conditions and coverage when drafting or negotiating cross-border contracts.
case.source_en: Source: Singapore International Arbitration Center · July 2026

policy.title: 粤港澳大湾区跨境纠纷在线调解平台正式启用，首日受理12宗涉港商事案
policy.summary: 由广东省司法厅、香港律政司及澳门法务局联合搭建的“粤港澳大湾区跨境纠纷在线调解平台”于7月20日上线。平台整合三地调解员名册，支持中英文及粤语调解，首日即受理12宗涉港商事纠纷，涵盖货物买卖、股权转让等领域。该平台旨在降低跨境争议解决成本，调解协议可申请三地法院司法确认。企业可在线提交申请，平均响应时间缩短至48小时。
policy.title_en: Guangdong-Hong Kong-Macao Greater Bay Area Cross-Border Online Mediation Platform Launches, Handles 12 Hong Kong-Related Commercial Cases on First Day
policy.summary_en: The 'Guangdong-Hong Kong-Macao Greater Bay Area Cross-Border Online Mediation Platform', jointly established by the Guangdong Provincial Department of Justice, the Hong Kong Department of Justice, and the Macao Legal Affairs Bureau, went online on July 20. The platform integrates mediator rosters from the three regions, supports mediation in Chinese, English, and Cantonese, and received 12 Hong Kong-related commercial disputes on its first day, covering goods sales, equity transfers, etc. It aims to reduce cross-border dispute resolution costs, and mediation agreements can be judicially confirmed by courts in all three regions. Enterprises can submit applications online, with average response time shortened to 48 hours.
policy.source_en: Source: Guangdong Provincial Department of Justice · 2026.07.21

analysis.title: 美国《生物安全法案》推进对中国药企的合规挑战及应对
analysis.summary: 秦林蒿律师研判：美国《生物安全法案》若通过，将限制联邦机构与受关注外国生物技术公司合作。中国CXO企业需立即建立供应链溯源体系，隔离美国客户数据，并考虑在第三国设立合规隔离实体。同时建议将合同中的“合规保证条款”升级，明确因法律变更导致的终止责任。短期内可申请豁免，但长期需调整全球布局。
analysis.title_en: Compliance Challenges for Chinese Pharma Under U.S. BIOSECURE Act and Countermeasures
analysis.summary_en: Attorney Qin's view: If the U.S. BIOSECURE Act is passed, it will restrict federal agencies from contracting with foreign biotechnology companies of concern. Chinese CRO/CDMOs should immediately establish supply chain traceability systems, isolate U.S. client data, and consider setting up compliant offshore entities in third countries. It is also advisable to upgrade 'compliance assurance clauses' in contracts to clarify termination liabilities due to legal changes. Short-term exemptions may be available, but long-term global restructuring is necessary.
